tickets.text: The protocol requires an outcome prediction even when a run is expected not to land, but neither the card nor CLI specifies a valid representation for that prediction; null and [null] are rejected.
A rejected probe-result consumes the pending probe state, so the identical probe must be requested again before correcting the prediction.
The empirically attainable maximum first-contact distance appears materially below the upper end of the declared goal space, so some high goals cannot be reached within tolerance.

Runs can have status no_landing, but experiment predictions and the theory API require a list of floats and provide no documented way to predict that discrete outcome; a JSON null prediction is rejected.
